title: Data Analysis, Visualisation & Evidence
code: Chapter 2 · From data to a defensible claim
html:
AP Computer Science Principles

Data Analysis
& Evidence

数据分析 · 可视化 · 证据与结论

Chapter 2 investigation · 90 minutes
note: 本课用L07清洗后的同一合成通勤表，把“表格能用”推进到“结论有证据且不过度推广”。学生要实际使用程序筛选、计算、看图，并写一份证据简报。无需写列表或循环代码。资料中的通勤数据完全合成，不代表真实学校、学生或研究发现。

title: Three tools from this chapter
html:
1. Does a higher sample count automatically increase the number of value levels?
  2. Which kind of compression permits exact reconstruction of the original data?
  3. Why do commute values need a unit label?
Show answer
1. No. Time sampling and value precision are separate.
2. Lossless.
3. A value such as 30 is ambiguous without knowing it means minutes rather than another unit.
note: 三题分别回顾采样、压缩、元数据。每题用一句解释，避免直接唱答案。lossless的精确对象是输入的原始数字数据，不是数字化之前模拟世界的全部细节。单位与采集背景在分析中仍然必要，不会因为已经清洗完而失去作用。

title: Build an evidence brief
html:
1. Choose a question the available fields can address.
  2. Filter, summarize and visualize data using a program.
  3. Write a claim with numbers and clear scope.
  4. Explain limitations and how analysis choices affect results.

Deliver: one question, two statistics, one chart, one limitation and a decision log.
note: 指出本节的交付物是分析简报，不是正式Create项目，也不是一段自动生成的“答案”。数量证据、图表和限制必须指向同一个问题。教师应看到学生真实切换筛选、核对样本数，而不是只抄最终均值表。

title: Start with a question that fits the data
html:
Fields: response ID, main mode, minutes, distance in km.

Addressable

How do reported commute times differ by mode in this sample?

Not established by this table

Which mode would make every student arrive faster?

What information is missing for the second question?

Show examples
Comparable routes and distances, repeated conditions, and evidence about what happens when a person changes mode.
note: 问题要从字段和采集过程出发。第一问描述样本内关联，可以分析；第二问包含反事实与因果判断，这张自愿单次表不足以回答。接受其他缺失信息如路况、等待时间，但不能把任何单一补充字段说成足以证明因果。表里已有distance，可用它提示不同模式人群并不相同。

title: Use the documented baseline
html:
16 raw rows → 13 usable records for this analysis.

  • Standardize the mode labels.
  • Remove one repeated ID; exclude one missing and one negative time.
  • Keep the 120-minute value; flag it as unusual.

Source: synthetic classroom data modeling a voluntary survey at one school on one morning.
note: 逐项核对16减3为13，标准化 bus 不删行。所有主分析默认保留120；无证据不能因为它拉高均值就判错。清洗规则存于data/chapter2-commute.json并由实验程序应用。若学生试算原始16行，把问题拉回已经定义的分析集合；保留原始表和排除日志，不覆盖数据来源。

title: Sorting and filtering do different jobs
html:
Sort · 排序

Reorder all 13 records by travel time.

Membership stays the same.

Filter · 筛选

Keep only records whose mode is Bus.

The view contains 6 records.

Does sorting alone change the mean of these values?

Show answer
No. The same values and count remain. A filter can change which values contribute.
note: 用三张数值卡片打乱再重排，学生看到和与数量未变。筛选保留Bus是一种分析视图，不等于把其他模式从原始数据中永久删除。排序有助于找中位数，但并不把最大值删除。实验已有模式筛选，无需学生编写布尔条件或假设有排序按钮。

title: Mean and median answer different questions
html:
8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 18, 20, 25, 28, 30, 35, 45, 120

Mean · 均值

sum ÷ count

381 ÷ 13 ≈ 29.31

Median · 中位数

The middle of the sorted values.

7th value = 20

Both are minutes, using all 13 usable records.
note: 先核对排序与13个数，中位数为第7个20，平均为381/13。均值和中位数是本课用于汇总的数学工具，并非要学生把它们当额外官方AP统计公式清单。120相对大，会使均值与中位数相差较明显；不要马上因此宣布中位数唯一正确。两种量回答不同概括问题，报告应说清选择。

title: Compare groups and report the counts
html:
ModenMean minutesMedian minutes
Walk411.2511
Bike317.6718
Bus647.1732.5

These describe the retained records, not every journey by each mode.

Which group has the largest mean in this sample?

Show answer
Bus. Its mean is about 47.17 minutes across 6 retained responses.
note: 均值保留两位小数，内部计算不先四舍五入。Bike的53/3约17.6667，Bus的283/6约47.1667，展示17.67与47.17。Bus中位数为排序后30和35的平均32.5。强调每组人数不同，不能把三个组均值直接简单平均当全样本均值。计数n是解释统计证据的一部分。

title: Make the chart tell the same story as the data
html:
Mean one-way commute time by mode · minutes

Synthetic voluntary sample · cleaned n = 13 · 120-minute record retained

What does the length of a bar summarize?

Show answer
The group mean, not every individual travel time. The chart also labels group counts.
note: 图为静态SVG，横向条形从零起，长度表示均值，不是人数。先读标题、单位、图形编码与caption，再看谁更长。学生不能从组均值图读出全部个体分布；要看原记录或其他图才知道组内差异。

title: Use language that matches the evidence
html:
Weak: “Buses make students late.”

Stronger: “Among the 13 retained responses in this synthetic sample, Bus has the highest mean reported commute time: 47.17 minutes (n = 6).”

Name two improvements in the revised claim.

Show possible answers
It identifies the sample and statistic, gives a number with units and count, and avoids claiming a causal effect or measuring lateness.
note: 弱句含两个跳跃：时间长并不等于迟到，因为没有arrivaldeadline字段；选择Bus和时间关联也不证明Bus造成。强句陈述已观察统计，明确本合成样本与n。词语如“proves”“all students”“best”需要特别检查。训练不是把所有结论都写得含糊，而是具体说数据实际支持什么。

title: Keep an unusual value; test sensitivity separately
html:
Analysis viewAll nAll meanAll median
Baseline: keep 1201329.31 min20 min
Optional: omit 1201221.75 min19 min

Bus mean changes from 47.17 (n=6) to 32.60 (n=5).

Does this change prove the 120-minute response is wrong?

Show answer
No. It shows that the summary depends on this observation. Report the comparison and retain the baseline without evidence of error.
note: 敏感性分析用明确替代选择观察结论稳定程度，不是“清洗掉不喜欢的数”。默认保留120，只有可验证错误或明确分析规则才改变主数据集。Bus删120后剩25、28、30、35、45，均值32.6；全样本均值从381/13降到261/12。教师不要说“修正后的均值21.75”，应说“排除120的替代视图”。

title: Association is not proof of cause
html:
The groups also report different travel distances.

ModeMean distanceMean time
Walk0.78 km11.25 min
Bike3.50 km17.67 min
Bus6.17 km47.17 min

Distance is a possible confounding factor; this comparison does not isolate an effect of mode.
note: 依据同13行独立计算距离均值0.775、3.5、6.1667，展示两位小数。没有声称已建立统计显著相关，也没有声称控制距离一定推翻结论。距离、路况和等待时间都可能有关，需要更完整、可比较资料和研究设计才能讨论因果。教“does not prove”而非“correlation means there is never causation”。

title: A clean sample can still be unrepresentative
html:
• One fictional school, one fictional morning.
  • Volunteers may differ from nonrespondents.
  • Travel times and distances are reported, not independently verified.

Would collecting more responses through the same biased process automatically remove the bias?

Show answer
No. More data may improve some estimates, but the source and collection process still matter.

Keep units, source, collection context and cleaning decisions with the chart.
note: 合成数据设计说明与对其假想采集过程的分析应分开：这些不是真实参与者；为了练习，按“一校一晨自愿调查”情境讨论限制。不要因为是合成资料就说无须思考抽样偏差，也不要用它作现实交通建议。metadata/provenance包括字段单位、来源、采集方式和处理记录，不只有文件大小。

title: Programs help scale analysis; checks still matter
html:
Useful work

Repeat filters, compute summaries, transform units and redraw charts.

Human decisions

Choose the question, validate rules and judge whether a claim is supported.

Large datasets may require more storage, computation or multiple computers.

A fast calculation can still use incorrect units, biased inputs or the wrong filter.
note: 当前13行可手算核查，较大数据通过程序才能有效重复处理，但程序能做并不等于自动正确。举例错误单位乘60也可迅速给出大量错误数值。C.7/C.8仅引入规模、资源和可能多计算机处理的需求，不教并行算法或系统设计，不声称本课掌握完整可扩展计算。

title: Your investigation brief
html:
Open Data Lab → Data analysis · Investigation sheet

  1. One question and the exact analysis view.
  2. Two statistics with units and sample counts.
  3. One labeled chart and one evidence-based claim.
  4. A limitation plus cleaning / sensitivity decisions.

Use the supplied synthetic data. Save your own completed brief.
note: 明确28分钟项目时间从55到83分钟。学生可纸笔填调查单，图表可准确临摹当前实验图并标轴、单位、n和处理视图，不依赖未实现的导出按钮。全班相同资料仍应各自写解释。二人共用设备必须交换操作，最后每人都能解释数字来源。该活动是数据调查练习，不叫正式Create任务。

title: 1 · Choose the question and document the view
html:
Start with the baseline: 13 retained records, including 120.

  1. Write an answerable question about time and mode.
  2. Record units, source and the 16 → 13 cleaning decisions.
  3. Predict what comparison would address the question.
Show a possible starting point
Example: “How do the mean reported times of Bus and Bike differ in this retained sample?” Compare each filtered mean and record both counts.
note: 5分钟先个人定问题，再同伴用字段表检查能否回答。提议学生比较Bus/Bike、Walk/Bike或全体均值中位数均可，但需要说明同一个分析目标。确定原始120保留，不因想得到某个结论预先删值。预测可以错；之后证据纠正预测本身是学习目标。

title: 2 · Use the program and verify two statistics
html:
Use the mode filter. Record values before changing the view.

  1. Select the views needed for your question.
  2. Write two statistics with units and n.
  3. Verify one small group using its displayed records.
Show baseline checks
Baseline examples: Walk mean 11.25 min, n=4; Bike mean 17.67 min, n=3; Bus mean 47.17 min, n=6.
note: 前4分钟操作与抄录，后3分钟交换角色手算一组，如Walk(8+10+12+15)/4=11.25。必须检查过滤器是否已回到需要的视图，防止把Bus统计和All计数拼在一起。实验内部保留精度，展示两位小数允许一致四舍五入。屏幕没显示的统计不要凭视觉猜；可用表中数据手算并注明方法。

title: 3 · Turn the comparison into a readable chart
html:
Record or sketch the group-mean chart from the lab.

  • Use a title naming the statistic and population shown.
  • Label mode categories and minutes; start bars at zero.
  • Show group counts and the treatment of 120.
  • Check that your written numbers match the chart’s view.
Show a caption example
A suitable caption: “Mean reported one-way time by mode; synthetic retained sample; Walk n=4, Bike n=3, Bus n=6; 120 retained.”
note: 如果当前lab模式筛选只突出组或只显示所选记录，要求先回到All观察完整组图，再标记选定比较；根据实际界面数据写，不杜撰不同视图。条形以零作为起点更适合比较长度。图表美化不计本次目标分，标题、单位、计数和与数字一致更重要。也要指出组均值图不展示个体差异。

title: 4 · Check sensitivity and state one limitation
html:
1. Record the baseline before omitting 120.
  2. Use the optional omission view; describe a change.
  3. Restore the baseline and label the alternative clearly.
  4. Write one limitation that your calculation cannot remove.
Show a comparison and limitation
All mean: 29.31 → 21.75 min; n: 13 → 12.
Possible limitation: one voluntary single-morning sample cannot establish population-wide or causal conclusions.
note: 敏感性实验并不要求学生改变主要结论，观察保持或变化都可。用全体均值便于同一检查；若学生只研究Walk/Bike，说明删除Bus记录不改变这两组均值，因此也可形成有价值的稳定性陈述。记录操作后恢复默认，简报写baseline和alternative，防止下一位用户误把删120后数据当主结果。

title: 5 · Review the claim and revise it
html:
Swap briefs. Check one another’s evidence.

  1. Can you reproduce the statistics from the stated view?
  2. Does the claim use the same units, groups and sample?
  3. Does it confuse association with cause?
  4. Is every exclusion or alternate view disclosed?
Show one useful revision
Example revision: replace “Bus causes longer commutes” with “Bus has a higher mean in this retained sample; distance and collection differences may also matter.”
note: 先2分钟审阅，2分钟修改，最后1分钟每人圈出具体改进句子。不能仅签“looks good”，至少核对一个数字和一个限制。要求保留初稿或用不同笔标注更改，体现反馈后修订。若同伴发现计算不一致，回到原始13行和当前filter检查，而不是选择更符合直觉的数字。

title: Chapter 2 check and hand-in
html:
Submit your evidence brief and decision log.

Homework: 12 questions · 30 classroom marks · about 40 minutes.

  • Sampling and compression retrieval.
  • Data quality, filtering and aggregation.
  • Charts, sensitivity and justified claims.

Use the provided figures and show your reasoning; the worksheet is not an official AP FRQ.
note: 本课作业是第二章综合检查，既有本课也有采样、压缩和数据质量。提醒Q5为恰选两项，4分书面题采用教师评分。分析简报可以在课后补充图表整洁度，但核心数字、操作与判断应在课内完成，便于观察真实理解。

title: Which two claims are supported?
html:
The retained sample has Walk mean 11.25 min (n=4) and Bus mean 47.17 min (n=6).

A. Bus has a higher sample mean.

B. Every Bus trip is longer than every possible Walk trip.

C. These figures alone establish that mode causes the difference.

D. These group counts are unequal.

Show exactly two answers
A and D. The figures describe group means and counts; they do not establish universal individual rankings or causation.
note: 两分钟快速诊断，A纯描述数据支持，D直接从n读取。B故意使用every possible，不可仅凭组均值推出；本表观察值是否全部Bus大于Walk也不能外推所有可能行程。C从关联跳因果。若学生争论本样本最短Bus25大于Walk最大15，表扬细读但回到possible的范围。

title: Exit ticket: evidence before confidence
html:
1. A filter selects Bus. What baseline count should you check?
  2. Does removing 120 for a comparison prove that record is invalid?
  3. Give one reason a difference in mean times does not establish that mode caused it.
Show answer
1. 6 records.
2. No. Sensitivity is different from evidence of an error.
3. Groups differ in distance or other conditions; this observational sample does not isolate mode’s effect.
note: 先90秒独立，余90秒收集与总结。三项各1分：正确计数、区分敏感性与纠错、有效替代解释或研究设计限制。建议3/3可结束本章；第2或3题错误需先针对结论边界补练，不能只凭会算均值判掌握。课堂有完整简报作为较强学习证据，exit仅作快速筛查。
